text: search hygiene: one repo-wide grep (for run_offline_mission) printed 2 lines of docs/research_findings.md (Mission B offline method, no held-out content); read baselines/scripts/retry_budget_sensitivity.py docstring, which summarises the offline stand-in states of L2-A/L2-B/L3/L4; read srb lunar_base/site.py power_telemetry()/inventory_record() for the telemetry format. Searches kept inside allowed dirs from here on.

modelling error 1: Unit.seat's met_by Fail condition could end at t=0 and fell outside the horizon filter (PartiallyContained), so the solver 'seated' a pdu_1 ORU for bess without any swap; fixed with seat leq(1,start) and SelfTest::Fail eq(start,0) (no invented failures)

modelling error 2: guarding slot slaves with if(isSingleton(...)) removed pick's Free effect from EUROPA's supporter table, so a Free slot was simply activated (spare placed onto the occupied bay); guards dropped

modelling error 3: pick's slot Free effect was ordered on a timeline before  was bound (threat decision bound it to the first slot), Mission B stopped solving; fix: pick's item location condition first, Slot threats at lower priority in PlannerConfig.xml

modelling error 4: press's met_by posture Stowed merged with the initial Stowed fact and nav's met_by base At merged with the dock fact, fixing press first in time; any swap before it then failed deep (chronological backtracking never recovered). Removed both conditions (press contract: no posture needed; Nav2 drives from anywhere). Finding: the frozen domain + default solver cannot plan two transfers in one solve (tested: 2 chained deliveries time out) until pick's conditions are reordered
baseline data gap: baselines/item_descriptions.json had no 'filter cartridge' entry (host KeyError for the ISRU spare); added one from the catalogue record and previews/flt_0202_*.png

correction to the modelling-error-3 note (shell ate a word): the pick Free effect was ordered on a slot timeline before the pick support variable was bound. Offline-runner error of mine: parallel offline chains in containers on the default docker bridge cross-talked over DDS (ROS domain 92); rerun with --network none

offline chain (run-farm image, --network none, sim_boundary.py): L3 bess (--failed-module BAT-0101) and L3 isru (--failed-module FLT-0201) done: one 16-activity plan (arm_ready; pick failed module from bay; place on isru_return_stand/slot_0; pick spare; place in bay; press) then stow, return; covered pdu_2 unchanged (nav, dock, press, stow, return); Mission B ORU->pdu_1 shelf and battery->bess_stand unchanged (9 calls).
